+ # ArzanSite Backend API - Comprehensive Guide
+ 
+ ## Table of Contents
+ 1. [System Overview](#system-overview)
+ 2. [Authentication & Security](#authentication--security)
+ 3. [API Endpoints](#api-endpoints)
+ 4. [Data Models](#data-models)
+ 5. [System Architecture](#system-architecture)
+ 6. [Integration with Appwrite](#integration-with-appwrite)
+ 7. [Deployment & Stability](#deployment--stability)
+ 
+ ## System Overview
+ 
+ ArzanSite is a comprehensive website design and hosting platform built with NestJS backend and Appwrite as the database/storage solution. The system provides:
+ 
+ - **User Management**: Registration, authentication, profiles
+ - **Order Management**: Website design orders with wizard interface
+ - **Payment Processing**: ZarinPal integration and wallet system
+ - **Design Tools**: Dynamic design creation and management
+ - **File Management**: Document and design file storage
+ - **Analytics**: User behavior and business analytics
+ - **Admin Controls**: Administrative oversight and management
+ 
+ ## Authentication & Security
+ 
+ ### JWT Authentication
+ All protected endpoints require JWT authentication via:
+ - `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header
+ - `appwrite_jwt` cookie (set by backend after session creation)
+ 
+ ### Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
+ - **User**: Basic access to own resources
+ - **Admin**: Administrative access to all resources
+ 
+ ### Security Features
+ - Helmet.js for security headers
+ - CORS protection with configurable origins
+ - Rate limiting (configurable per endpoint)
+ - Input validation and sanitization
+ - SQL injection protection via Appwrite
+ 
+ ## API Endpoints
+ 
+ ### Base URL
+ ```
+ Production: https://app.arzansite.com/api
+ Development: http://localhost:3000/api
+ ```
+ 
+ ### 1. Authentication (`/auth`)
+ 
+ #### User Registration
+ ```http
+ POST /api/auth/signup
+ Content-Type: application/json
+ 
+ {
+   "email": "user@example.com",
+   "password": "SecurePassword123!",
+   "metadata": {
+     "name": "John Doe",
+     "first_name": "John",
+     "last_name": "Doe",
+     "company": "Example Corp",
+     "phone": "+1234567890",
+     "address": "123 Main St, City, Country"
+   }
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ **Response:**
+ ```json
+ {
+   "success": true,
+   "data": {
+     "message": "User created successfully. Please check your email to verify your account.",
+     "user": {
+       "id": "64f8a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0",
+       "email": "user@example.com",
+       "emailVerification": false,
+       "$createdAt": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
+     },
+     "verificationEmailSent": true,
+     "requiresFrontendVerification": false
+   },
+   "timestamp": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ #### User Login
+ ```http
+ POST /api/auth/signin
+ Content-Type: application/json
+ 
+ {
+   "email": "user@example.com",
+   "password": "SecurePassword123!"
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ **Response:**
+ ```json
+ {
+   "success": true,
+   "data": {
+     "user": {
+       "id": "64f8a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0",
+       "email": "user@example.com",
+       "emailVerification": true
+     },
+     "session": {
+       "id": "session_123",
+       "userId": "64f8a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0",
+       "expire": "2024-01-08T00:00:00.000Z"
+     }
+   },
+   "timestamp": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ #### Email Verification
+ ```http
+ POST /api/auth/verify-email
+ Content-Type: application/json
+ 
+ {
+   "token": "verification_token_here",
+   "userId": "64f8a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0"
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ #### Password Reset
+ ```http
+ POST /api/auth/send-password-reset
+ Content-Type: application/json
+ 
+ {
+   "email": "user@example.com"
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ ```http
+ POST /api/auth/reset-password
+ Content-Type: application/json
+ 
+ {
+   "token": "reset_token_here",
+   "email": "user@example.com",
+   "newPassword": "NewSecurePassword123!"
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ #### OAuth Authentication
+ ```http
+ POST /api/auth/oauth/github/start
+ Content-Type: application/json
+ 
+ {
+   "successUrl": "https://arzansite.com/auth/success",
+   "failureUrl": "https://arzansite.com/auth/failure"
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ ### 2. User Profiles (`/profiles`)
+ 
+ #### Get Profile
+ ```http

+ 
+ #### Update Profile
+ ```http

+ 
+ ### 3. Orders (`/orders`)

+ **Response:**

+ 
+ #### Get User Orders
+ ```http

+ ## System Architecture
+ 
+ ### High-Level Architecture
+ 
+ ```
+ ┌─────────────────┐    ┌──────────────────┐    ┌─────────────────┐
+ │   Frontend      │    │   NestJS API     │    │   Appwrite      │
+ │   (React/Vue)   │◄──►│   Backend        │◄──►│   Backend       │
+ │                 │    │                  │    │   Services      │
+ └─────────────────┘    └──────────────────┘    └─────────────────┘
+                               │
+                               ▼
+                        ┌──────────────────┐
+                        │   External       │
+                        │   Services       │
+                        │   (ZarinPal,    │
+                        │    SMTP, etc.)   │
+                        └──────────────────┘
+ ```
+ 
+ ### Module Structure
+ 
+ ```
+ src/
+ ├── app.module.ts                 # Main application module
+ ├── main.ts                       # Application bootstrap
+ ├── appwrite/                     # Appwrite integration
+ │   ├── appwrite.service.ts      # Core Appwrite operations
+ │   ├── appwrite.config.ts       # Configuration
+ │   ├── database.controller.ts    # Database operations
+ │   ├── storage.controller.ts     # File storage
+ │   ├── functions.controller.ts   # Cloud functions
+ │   └── messaging.controller.ts   # Push notifications
+ ├── auth/                         # Authentication system
+ │   ├── auth.controller.ts        # Auth endpoints
+ │   ├── auth.service.ts          # Auth business logic
+ │   └── dto/                     # Data transfer objects
+ ├── orders/                       # Order management
+ │   ├── enhanced-orders.controller.ts
+ │   ├── enhanced-orders.service.ts
+ │   └── dto/
+ ├── wallets/                      # Wallet system
+ │   ├── enhanced-wallets.controller.ts
+ │   ├── enhanced-wallets.service.ts
+ │   └── dto/
+ ├── payments/                     # Payment processing
+ │   ├── enhanced-payments.controller.ts
+ │   ├── enhanced-payments.service.ts
+ │   ├── zarinpal.service.ts      # ZarinPal integration
+ │   └── dto/
+ ├── invoices/                     # Invoice management
+ ├── receipts/                     # Digital receipts
+ ├── designs/                      # Design management
+ ├── wizard/                       # Website wizard
+ ├── uploads/                      # File uploads
+ ├── analytics/                    # Analytics & reporting
+ ├── notifications/                # Notification system
+ ├── admin/                        # Admin controls
+ ├── scheduled-tasks/              # Automated tasks
+ ├── site-config/                  # Site configuration
+ ├── domains/                      # Domain management
+ ├── email/                        # Email services
+ └── common/                       # Shared components
+     ├── guards/                   # Authentication guards
+     ├── interceptors/             # Response transformers
+     ├── filters/                  # Exception handling
+     └── decorators/               # Custom decorators
+ ```
+ 
+ ### Data Flow
+ 
+ 1. **Client Request** → **NestJS Controller**
+ 2. **Controller** → **Service Layer** (Business Logic)
+ 3. **Service** → **AppwriteService** (Data Operations)
+ 4. **AppwriteService** → **Appwrite Backend** (Database/Storage)
+ 5. **Response** → **Interceptor** (Transform/Format)
+ 6. **Formatted Response** → **Client**
+ 
+ ### Security Flow
+ 
+ 1. **Request** → **JWT Guard** (Token Validation)
+ 2. **JWT Guard** → **Appwrite/Backend JWT Verification**
+ 3. **Validated Request** → **Roles Guard** (Permission Check)
+ 4. **Authorized Request** → **Controller/Service**
+

+ APPWRITE_DATABASE_ID=your_database_id
+ APPWRITE_WEBHOOK_SECRET=your_webhook_secret
